findings.title: Top Gross Profit Item - Exact Item Economics
findings.claim: Item 'Spanish Latte' (SKU: HOT-001) generated the highest gross profit of 3872.70 SAR during the analysis period, with 306 units sold at 70.9% gross margin.
coverage_notes: Analysis includes all non-refund POS transactions during 2026-01-26 to 2026-02-02
Only items with non-null unit_cost_sar in menu are included
assumptions: Menu unit_cost_sar represents actual COGS per unit
POS line_total_sar is accurate revenue after discounts
No waste adjustments applied (waste data not linked to POS items)

findings.title: Quantified Waste Cost Impact
findings.claim: Known waste cost of 1136.50 SAR was recorded for 188 units during the week of 2026-01-26, representing 5.64% of revenue from affected items.
coverage_notes: Revenue calculated from POS for affected SKUs
assumptions: Waste items correspond to POS SKUs

findings.title: Supplier Price Change Detection
findings.claim: Supplier price change detected for full-fat milk: 7.10 SAR/L → 8.40 SAR/L (+18.3%), effective 2026-05-01.
coverage_notes: Most recent price change from supplier emails
No standing order quantities found to calculate procurement cost scenario
Price change may not yet be reflected in current menu costs
assumptions: Email extraction accurately captured price and effective date
Price change applies to future purchases
No recipe/BOM available to calculate per-drink impact
